description: Veilplane's shared Renovate settings. Every repository that Renovate keeps up to date extends this preset
("extends": ["github>veilplane/workflows//renovate/base"]), so the rules live in one place.
- config:recommended: Renovate's sensible defaults (dependency dashboard, monorepo groups, known workarounds).
- minimumReleaseAge: a new version is proposed only once it is 14 days old. Broken or malicious releases are
usually found and pulled within days; waiting costs little. Security fixes are not delayed (vulnerabilityAlerts).
- Major updates always get their own pull request and are never merged automatically.
- Pull requests are labelled "dependencies" and opened Monday mornings (Europe/Berlin), at most 5 at once.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Known vulnerabilities: proposed at once, whatever the schedule and the release age.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: one pull request for all non-major updates of the actions used in workflows.
